The Wikipedia page on [Sequence analysis in social sciences](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sequence_analysis_in_social_sciences) has been redesigned and replaces the previous *Social sequence analysis* page. It provides useful background for sequence analysis studies.

A link to the page is also listed on our [Resources](../../../resources.qmd) page.
